title: Walk Slowly, but Never Backward
coreMove: Move from planning into repeated reps before judging the habit by quality.
sourcePressure: Progress comes from repeated action and accumulated reps, not from waiting for a flawless beginning.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Equating motion with progress or using preparation to avoid the first imperfect rep.

hook: starting with a definition of motion
counterintuition: the problem is not motivation alone

exampleSpecs.domain: a glassblower learning through fifty uneven practice gathers
exampleSpecs.audience: an apprentice waiting to plan the perfect vase
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether reps teach heat timing faster than sketches
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he ruins the forty-first gather, writes one note, and returns to the furnace before redesigning the whole piece
exampleSpecs.firstImage: orange glass glowing at the end of a blowpipe

exampleSpecs.domain: a court mediator practicing opening statements with real timers
exampleSpecs.audience: a mediator hiding in article reading
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether action replaces motion before the first live case
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: her mentor stops the research pile and starts a three-minute mock opening with the stopwatch running
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a stopwatch beside a stack of mediation articles

exampleSpecs.domain: a canoe guide tying knots badly for ten mornings before guests arrive
exampleSpecs.audience: a seasonal guide embarrassed by clumsy hands
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether repetition beats more knot diagrams
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he ties the bowline each morning on the dock cleat until his hands stop searching
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a wet rope looped around a dock cleat

exampleSpecs.domain: a podcast producer publishing rough internal pilots instead of buying more gear
exampleSpecs.audience: a producer stuck in setup mode
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether bad first episodes produce feedback planning cannot
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she exports the third rough cut to the private feed before opening another microphone review
exampleSpecs.firstImage: an audio waveform paused beside unopened gear boxes

exampleSpecs.domain: a pharmacy tech learning compounding labels through repeated practice batches
exampleSpecs.audience: a trainee worried about first-pass perfection
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether safe reps reveal spacing errors before real prescriptions
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the supervisor lines up ten practice labels and shows the spacing mistake shrinking across attempts
exampleSpecs.firstImage: practice labels spread beside an empty amber vial tray

exampleSpecs.domain: a trail-maintenance volunteer swinging a Pulaski through awkward first cuts
exampleSpecs.audience: a volunteer reading manuals to avoid looking foolish
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the first poor cuts create the skill map
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he makes six ugly notches, then adjusts grip because the trail boss points at the chips, not the manual
exampleSpecs.firstImage: wood chips scattered around a trail log

tryThisNowSpec: Do one imperfect rep of a habit you have been preparing for. Stop after the rep and note what practice taught that planning did not.
